temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days; when Carolyn asks if she is alright, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed Marilyn was normally engaging and sociable; she had noticed unusual quietness but did not yet know the reason.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn's explanation confirms that her withdrawal is not typical reserve but is connected to feeling overwhelmed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is struggling with work and personal stress, and her quietness is likely due to being overwhelmed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to offer support and be available if Marilyn wants to talk

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn had been curt in a recent interaction, which confused and slightly hurt Carolyn; when Carolyn apologizes for possibly overstepping and shares her own tough times, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes for seeming off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After the first conversation, Carolyn believed Marilyn was overwhelmed; after Marilyn's curtness, Carolyn began to wonder whether she had overstepped or whether Marilyn was upset with her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn's response clarifies that her curtness was not a rejection of Carolyn but a result of her own hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is not upset with Carolyn; she is stressed and appreciates Carolyn's support and openness.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: relieved and reassured, with lingering care and concern
temporal_state_chain.intention: to clear up any misunderstanding and continue showing support

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn appeared to respond positively to Carolyn's openness, and when Carolyn invites her to a small get-together, Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks her, and says she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed their relationship was improving and felt relieved and hopeful about a budding friendship; she thought Marilyn might be receptive to social contact.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn's acceptance confirms and strengthens Carolyn's belief that Marilyn is interested in friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is willing to socialize outside work and is interested in building a friendship.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to strengthen their bond and look forward to the gathering with Marilyn

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives Marilyn as still maintaining professional distance at the bank; when Carolyn raises the work dynamic, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk and improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After the invitation, Carolyn believed their friendship was growing; however, she now perceives a professional distance from Marilyn at work, which conflicts with her earlier expectation and makes her feel disappointed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn's response suggests the distance may be unintentional or not fully recognized, and she is open to discussing and improving it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: There is a work dynamic issue to resolve, but Marilyn is not intentionally distancing herself and is willing to work on their collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: disappointed and confused initially, then cautiously reassured and hopeful
temporal_state_chain.intention: to address the perceived distance and improve their work relationship

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they cleared the air and understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; when she proposes teaming up on the new project proposal, Marilyn says it is a great idea, is glad they talked, and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Following the work-dynamic discussion, Carolyn believes they have cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; she feels content and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn's enthusiastic agreement confirms Carolyn's belief that their partnership has improved and can deepen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: They have a stronger, more understanding professional partnership, and Marilyn is eager to collaborate closely.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to further their partnership by working together on the new project proposal
